comment: The sop window («Тактичний планшет», the tube-monitor tablet): every picture the mockup draws with CSS.
Sizes are layout units; drawn at 1.5 px per unit. White shapes are tinted in the game (the layout's color or SetColor);
the textures with their own colours (bezel, glow, hud, tree_glow, crt_lines, fog_stripes) are shown with color 1 1 1 1.
The rules are the mockup's own CSS (body[data-f=sop] and the base it builds on), lifted into sop.css.
crt_lines and fog_stripes are pixel tiles: the game repeats a picture shown without stretching at one texel per
screen pixel, so they are drawn at exactly 16 and 32 pixels (w x 1.5 = size) and keep the mockup's pattern in
pixels: scanlines 2 of 4 at 1920x1080, the 135-degree stripes of the fog at 3840x1600.
The game blends in LINEAR light (measured 2026-10-31), so every partly transparent picture carries a compensated
alpha and the tree's glow is baked opaque over its lcd; sop.css says which and why.
